messages:
claire-sales: Quick sync  Marigold POC asks: SAML SSO + SCIM provisioning + RBAC via groups + domain ownership verification. Need a 1-pg runbook and two pricing options (hosted vs dedicated).

mike-solutions: We support SAML 2.0 (IdP & SP-initiated). Request IdP metadata XML + public cert. Persistent NameID (email) ok. We support signed assertions (RSA-SHA256). Encrypted assertions optional; ACS URL: https://api.redwood.ai/saml/acs/<tenant>.

diego-eng: SCIM 2.0: /scim/v2/Users and /scim/v2/Groups, PATCH for group membership. Bulk create up to 200 users/req. Default Hosted rate limit 8 req/s per tenant (burst allowed). Group->role mapping: provision groups and map displayName -> Redwood role in Console for flexibility. Note: group change propagation ~20-45s to live role cache.

rachel-security: Security checklist items to request: IdP cert thumbprint, NameID format, required attributes, whether assertion encryption required, SCIM auth method (OAuth bearer vs mTLS), token rotation cadence, IP allowlist. For Dedicated we can enable mTLS and stricter CIDR allowlist. Domain verification: DNS TXT recommended; email challenge optional.

claire-sales: POC scope: 30 users initial, may ramp. Buyer asked about cost delta hosted vs dedicated.

mike-solutions: Quick pricing bullets: Hosted = small monthly base + per-active-user/month + provisioning API metering (per-1k calls). Dedicated = monthly reserved capacity with provisioning allowance; overage billed. I'll draft a worked example for 30 and 500 users.

ticket-bot: [automated] Created ticket MARIGOLD-POC-301 and attached SAML/SCIM checklist.

diego-eng: Minimal SCIM example for runbook:

POST /scim/v2/Users
Authorization: Bearer <token>
Content-Type: application/json
{ "userName": "alice.lee@marigold.com", "name": {"givenName":"Alice","familyName":"Lee"}, "emails": [{"value":"alice.lee@marigold.com","primary":true}] }

claire-sales: Action items: @diego-eng prepare 1-pg runbook (ACS, entityID, SAML attr map, SCIM snippets), @rachel-security fill questionnaire answers and provide SOC links, @mike-solutions draft pricing bullets. Target: 48hrs, then I'll send to buyer.
